recent_excerpts: CISA ordered federal agencies to patch CVE-2026-96652 and three other exploited flaws in Plex Media Server (Plex2Shell), Siemens, and SiteGuard by the November deadline.
Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,413 CVEs, led by CVE-2026-96951 (CVSS 8.8), a Windows Mark of the Web bypass exploited in the wild and added to CISA KEV.
CISA set an October 11 federal patch deadline after Flax Typhoon exploited CVE-2015-3306, a CVSS 10.0 ProFTPD flaw, plus four other bugs in its KEV batch.
